status_definitions.implemented: Source implements the stated operation; this is not an installed-platform or release qualification.
status_definitions.qualified-bounded: Historical native acceptance exists only for the stated cases and recorded source.
status_definitions.experimental: Implemented pieces or contracts exist, with the stated qualification gaps.
status_definitions.known-defect: A concrete method or correctness defect prevents the advertised guarantee.
status_definitions.unsupported: Current execution is explicitly unavailable; no alternative host core is supported.
status_definitions.planned: An approved implementation or research plan exists; capability is not delivered.

native49.scope: Recorded MPI 2/4-rank cases and Mac ARM64/Colab Linux x86-64 gRPC cases; historical bounded acceptance.

native_linux.scope: GitHub run 45051171243. Installed Rust SDK, C ABI v1, CPython 3.15.2 and CareOps contention on Linux x86-64 GNU.

native_macos.scope: GitHub run 45051171243. Installed Rust SDK, C ABI v1, CPython 3.15.2 and CareOps contention on macOS ARM64.

native_science.scope: 80 exact-source native Rust cases and one independent Arrow readback on Apple Silicon

capabilities.name: Deterministic Rust scheduling, state and RNG
capabilities.scope: The installed Rust 1.99.1 SDK passed the standalone service-station consumer and seeded ABM replay on Linux x86-64 GNU and macOS ARM64 at e287538.
capabilities.limitations: The native-core-v1 profile defines the candidate's supported slice. Alpha seeded replay uses a different RNG version.

capabilities.name: DES and ABM modelling
capabilities.scope: Rust resources, agent behavior and routes include scheduled movement, cancellation, replanning, lease cleanup and committed occupancy export.
capabilities.limitations: The verified cases cover tick order, conservation, transfer expiry, backpressure and movement lease cleanup. General hybrid coupling and empirical model validation remain S17 work.

capabilities.name: C ABI scheduling and statistics
capabilities.scope: The installed C ABI v1 archive passed lifecycle, timing, cancellation and statistics cases on Linux x86-64 GNU and macOS ARM64 at e287538.
capabilities.limitations: ABI v1 exposes counters. Dispatch identities and model or RNG controls require other interfaces.

capabilities.name: Python NativeEngine
capabilities.scope: NativeEngine drove the installed C ABI v1 library from CPython 3.15.2 on Linux x86-64 GNU and macOS ARM64 at e287538.
capabilities.limitations: The tested profile requires an explicitly selected library. Legacy Scheduler is retired. More Python versions and targets need installed qualification.

capabilities.name: TypeScript loader and Rust Wasm scheduler
capabilities.scope: Generated wasm-bindgen module owns simulation execution.
capabilities.limitations: Generated-artefact execution and safe API qualification are separate gates; current run_for maps native error to zero and JSON u64 statistics need precision handling. Inspector/debug metadata is unqualified.

capabilities.name: R, Julia and Go simulation adapters
capabilities.scope: DTOs and package metadata may remain available.
capabilities.limitations: Simulation constructors fail or are unavailable until real Rust dispatch is implemented and separately qualified.

capabilities.name: C# native ABI declarations
capabilities.scope: Raw native lifecycle/schedule/run/statistics APIs can call the Rust ABI.
capabilities.limitations: Managed DeterministicScheduler is retired; actual native CI and installed-package qualification are separate.

capabilities.name: Python Gymnasium environment
capabilities.scope: The optional Gymnasium and PettingZoo hosts drive a Rust queue through the queue-env-v1 CLI. Both installed checkers passed on macOS.
capabilities.limitations: The preview needs a CLI built with rl-queue and POSIX pipes. Its evidence covers one queue model and CPython 3.15.2.

capabilities.name: Optimistic/distributed Rust runtime
capabilities.scope: Recorded MPI 2/4-rank and two-host gRPC tests cover specified rollback, crash/restart and fixed-LP entity transfer cases.
capabilities.limitations: Historical acceptance applies to recorded sources and cases; no cross-host MPI, whole-LP relocation, cluster or scaling certification.

capabilities.name: Measured PDES performance baseline
capabilities.scope: The e287538 conservative-PDES ring preserved final-state parity across 120 paired samples. Serial had lower median time in all eight measured cases.
capabilities.limitations: The ring covers 4 to 32 logical processes and 1,024 to 8,192 processed events. Larger models and GPU or distributed crossover require matched-workload evidence.

capabilities.name: HPC weak/strong scaling certification
capabilities.scope: Benchmark scaffolding and synthetic report generation exist.
capabilities.limitations: Formula-generated 92%/84% and 3.36x are not measurements and cannot certify scaling.

capabilities.name: GPU acceleration
capabilities.scope: Hardware execution covers bounded resident particle and additive DES cases on Apple Metal and RTX 4060 CUDA. Metal tests cover exact integer state, snapshots and recovery.
capabilities.limitations: Float comparisons use model-specific tolerances. Timings apply to the measured device, model and batch sizes. General models, browser GPU and scaling remain open.

capabilities.name: Arrow/Polars data interchange
capabilities.scope: Optional Rust Arrow/Polars interchange supports populated domain tables and C Data and Stream exports. Installed CareOps and Innovate cases verified schema and retained buffers.
capabilities.limitations: The generic C ABI telemetry call returns JSON statistics. The installed Arrow evidence covers the recorded CareOps and Innovate optional data paths.

capabilities.name: Classical fourth-order integration
capabilities.scope: Kairos game-theory 0.3.0 withdraws the legacy RK4 export. Paignia owns qualified fixed-step replicator integration.
capabilities.limitations: The Paignia qualification covers its declared replicator profile. General ODE integration remains conditional on Track 102.

capabilities.name: Mixed Nash and Lemke–Howson
capabilities.scope: Kairos game-theory 0.5.0 retires the legacy mixed-strategy surface. Paignia owns bounded mixed-Nash solving and candidate admission.
capabilities.limitations: Paignia requires verified finite witnesses within its support search and reports Lemke–Howson as unsupported. Kairos retains pure-strategy and experimental zero-sum minimax helpers.

capabilities.name: Correlated-equilibrium optimisation
capabilities.scope: Kairos game-theory 0.4.0 retires its correlated-equilibrium surface. Paignia owns the optional bounded solver and its certificate.
capabilities.limitations: Paignia admits complete two-player payoff tables and an explicit objective within the declared bounds. Kairos retains experimental zero-sum minimax.

capabilities.name: General CFR/CFR+
capabilities.scope: Kairos game-theory 0.2.0 retires the public Kuhn-specific solver. Paignia owns bounded vanilla CFR and CFR+.
capabilities.limitations: Historical Kuhn controls are test-only. Paignia supports its declared finite, perfect-recall information-set profile; legacy LinearCfr is unsupported.

capabilities.name: Standard Sobol and sensitivity analysis
capabilities.scope: Versioned Joe–Kuo D(6) Sobol points cover up to 16 dimensions and match frozen SciPy vectors. Jansen sensitivity intervals were checked on Ishigami and Sobol-G.
capabilities.limitations: The checked index space is 32-bit. The legacy sequence remains versioned for replay. Interval evidence covers the recorded models and replicate counts.

capabilities.name: CRN, ensembles and uncertainty
capabilities.scope: Rust implements paired common random numbers, sequential ABC-SMC and competing-risk clocks. Tests exercise an exact beta posterior, branch coupling and analytical hazard and censoring cases.
capabilities.limitations: Calibration and interval evidence covers the named reference models and assumptions. New application and empirical claims require their own validation.

capabilities.name: Opt-in ONNX CPU and Rust affine inference
capabilities.scope: A bound ONNX Runtime CPU session executes fixed-shape float32 models from the Rust tick hook. The affine surrogate reports held-out error and rejects extrapolation.
capabilities.limitations: The recorded ONNX model has one fixed input and output. Broader ONNX port and operator profiles, TensorRT and Burn remain unsupported.

capabilities.name: External FMI/FMU interoperability
capabilities.scope: Native FMI 2 and 3 Reference FMU co-simulation and archive round-trips passed independent trajectory and state-replay checks. An OpenModelica time-event model exercised the Linux importer.
capabilities.limitations: Qualification covers the admitted co-simulation models, events, targets and state capabilities. Other FMUs and model-exchange need their own evidence.

capabilities.name: NUMA, parallel I/O and model restart
capabilities.scope: The native Arrow IPC, HDF5 and ADIOS2 BP5 paths write typed files. The installed service-queue restart matched 228 remaining dispatches and final counters.
capabilities.limitations: Results cover local native files and the named restart fixture. Live parallel filesystems, additional workloads, NUMA and cross-host scaling remain open.

capabilities.name: Native replay and Arrow dispatch export
capabilities.scope: The Rust debugger restores retained checkpoints and isolates forks. The source-built optional CLI exports the retained dispatch interval through its final cursor as Arrow event-log v2.
capabilities.limitations: The export carries dispatch metadata only. Model checkpoints, RNG state, full trace history, production model qualification and browser time travel are outside the export profile.

capabilities.name: Native telemetry transport
capabilities.scope: Loopback OS processes exchange typed framed-TCP messages. The Tonic telemetry RPC validates native Arrow IPC, orders merged records and rejects duplicate conflicts and invalid tails.
capabilities.limitations: The TCP suite checks bounded queues and protocol failures locally. Browser WebSocket, Kafka, NATS and Arrow Flight are unavailable as native adapters.

capabilities.name: Independent CareOps consumer contract
capabilities.scope: Hosted installed contention passed both profile targets. Archived CareOps cases cover replay, populated domain schema, retained buffers and one step-free porter movement on macOS ARM64.
capabilities.limitations: CareOps owns its application adapter, production pin and domain model validation.

capabilities.name: Beta and stable release
capabilities.scope: The native-core-v1 beta candidate e287538 passed both clean installations. Signed SPDX evidence names the exact tested archive digests.
capabilities.limitations: Maintainer acceptance is pending. The published version remains v0.4.0-alpha.1. Stable release gates remain separate.

capabilities.name: Beyond-frontier research claims
capabilities.scope: Predeclared experiments cover deterministic execution planning, policy branching and executable evidence.
capabilities.limitations: No universal leadership or scientific novelty is asserted before independent baselines, held-out evaluation and reproduction.
